projects.title: Solar System Missions
projects.shortDescription: Explore spacecraft missions through NASA JPL Horizons data and generated trajectory plots.
projects.problem: Real mission data is powerful, but difficult to explore without specialized tools.
projects.approach: Query public ephemeris data, discover mission ranges, and turn vectors into a web-based mission story and trajectory image.
projects.limitation: The network-dependent workflow still needs current end-to-end API validation.

projects.title: Gesture-Reactive Avatar
projects.shortDescription: A local avatar that calibrates to a face and reacts to expressions in real time.
projects.problem: A lightweight streaming avatar needs to feel responsive without uploading camera frames.
projects.approach: Measure facial landmarks locally, calibrate to the current user, smooth rapid changes, and select reaction images.
projects.limitation: Thresholds and camera behavior need testing across more faces, lighting, and devices.

projects.title: Ambient Dashboard
projects.shortDescription: A calm desktop workspace for priorities, progress, and focus sessions.
projects.problem: Daily state should be visible without becoming another noisy task manager.
projects.approach: Combine reusable progress controls, local persistence, theme palettes, and a focus timer inside a desktop shell.
projects.limitation: Weather, calendar integration, component tests, and native packaging remain future work.

projects.title: HandwritingConverter
projects.shortDescription: Turn photographed notes into reviewable text, confidence reports, and printable PDFs.
projects.problem: Handwriting is quick for thinking, but paper notes are difficult to search, revise, and print.
projects.approach: Preprocess images locally, run OCR, report page confidence, and create text, HTML review, and PDF outputs.
projects.limitation: Recognition quality still depends on handwriting, lighting, camera angle, and Tesseract language data.

projects.title: VoxNav
projects.shortDescription: A Windows voice-control assistant with explicit commands and a safe preview mode.
projects.problem: Hands-free desktop navigation needs predictable commands and visible safety boundaries.
projects.approach: Parse normalized transcripts into allowlisted actions, trace each decision, and provide a side-effect-free text preview.
projects.limitation: Speech currently uses an external service; real desktop actions still need intentional manual testing.

projects.title: Yoga Pose Match
projects.shortDescription: A browser-based pose game with live landmark feedback and joint-specific coaching.
projects.problem: Pose-estimation data needs friendly feedback before it feels like a movement game.
projects.approach: Compare browser camera landmarks to data-derived angle targets and name the joint furthest from its target.
projects.limitation: Camera behavior and pose accuracy still require cross-device testing.

projects.title: Stop Time Blindness
projects.shortDescription: A browser focus timer that keeps task progress visible in Picture-in-Picture.
projects.problem: Elapsed time becomes easy to lose track of when a timer is hidden behind active work.
projects.approach: Render task progress to a canvas, stream it into an always-on-top Picture-in-Picture window, and keep a private local session log.
projects.limitation: Picture-in-Picture behavior and media restrictions still vary across browsers and operating systems.
